title: Aurelia Project Configuration Editor Assistance
description: Offline, non-validating completion hints for aurelia.project.json. Semantic-runtime owns semantic project-configuration validation.

excludedRoots.description: Project-relative descendant directory roots that remain readable as dependencies but are not authored project sources.

findings.description: Projection-only policy for admitted semantic finding rules. It does not remove underlying analysis evidence.

aurelia.analysis.dynamic-registration-sp.description: Whether and at what presentation level this exact semantic finding is projected.

additionalProperties.description: Disposition suggestions for manually entered finding IDs. Semantic-runtime determines whether an ID is known and valid.
